en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small historic European town on a hill surrounded by forested valleys. Dense rows of gabled houses and stone buildings cluster along the ridge. A prominent church with a tall tower and baroque‑style dome stands near the center, and a larger fortress‑like complex or castle occupies the skyline behind it. In the foreground, a curving road leads past a large villa at the bottom of the slope. The image has no visible caption or printed text on the front.
